messages:
Asha (People Ops): Quick follow-up from today's All-Hands Q&A. Dropping concise answers + links so managers can copy into 1:1s.

Omar (Eng Manager): Timeline first: when do managers need packets? A few folks asked.

Asha (People Ops): Packet deadline: 2026-09-20. Calibration panels: 2026-09-27. Letters targeted 2026-10-04. Appeals open for 14 calendar days after letters.

Ria (SWE): If an appeal is approved, do we backdate pay? Team wants clarity on payroll timing.

Liam (Comp): Approved base changes are backdated to the cycle effective date in the committee memo and paid on the next payroll after HR posts the change (usually ~2 weeks). Equity adjustments follow normal grant cadence unless an off-cycle grant is approved.

Omar (Eng Manager): Folks asked about comp compression at the top of bands. Is there a special path?

Asha (People Ops): Compression cases: include market comps + proposed remedy (base vs equity mix) in the packet. Comp team reviews for possible regrade or targeted equity.

Ria (SWE): Will promotions auto-trigger equity refreshes? Also, international folks—how do we handle local market differences?

Asha (People Ops): Promotions don't automatically grant equity. Check the "equity request" box in the packet with rationale. For international hires include local market data and USD equivalent; we review locality adjustments with comp.

PeopleBot: Reminder: upload the calibration-template to /handbook/people-ops/calibration/2026-fall by 2026-09-20. :pushpin:

Sam (CEO): Manager note: be explicit about next steps and milestones if someone isn't promoted. Leadership will escalate retention-worthy cases if flagged with business impact.

Asha (People Ops): Actionables for managers (copy/paste): 1) Use calibration-template in handbook 2) Flag equity/compression cases with evidence 3) Add return-to-work annotation for leaves 4) Finalize packets by 2026-09-20. Ping me for urgent escalations. :sparkles:
